decision.body:
thank you!

left some nits you should address before landing

inline_comments.body:
This is BC breaking, though I think this is the preferred setup in the future (things are in headeronly and exposed elsewhere). 

Could you add a BC breaking note following the guidelines in https://docs.google.com/document/d/14OmgGBr1w6gl1VO47GGGdwrIaUNr92DFhQbY_NEk8mQ/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.a9htwgvvec1m

nit, but codex says:

```
`torch/headeronly/core/AccumulateType.h:82-90` — Generic macros such as `ACC_TYPE` can redefine and then erase caller macros. Prefix them with `TORCH_HEADERONLY_` before undefining them.
```

this was true before already, but since torch/headeronly is more visible we can be more intentional about it.

```suggestion
`acc_type<T, is_cuda>` and `acc_type_device<T, DeviceType>` give the dtype a
```

wider isn't always accurate, right?
